items.title: Actual global weighted resolvent scalar coercivity

source.anchor: PBPS arXiv2609.06905v1 Section2.2 reflected conditional Poincare and AppendixC.1 omitted full-space coercivity background; SPHMC arXiv2609.06906v1 Section4.1 BL covariance-upper background. Positive-epsilon global scalar resolvent bound is an authored analytic prerequisite, not a numbered paper theorem, Poincare or BL.
source.attribution: Samplinglib authored full-space positive-epsilon scalar prerequisite toward PBPS conditional Poincare and SPHMC BL; not a quoted numbered theorem or complete paper result.

items.statement: Given the genuine source-neutral hypotheses, produce ONE actual u in the SAME original D.closure.domain for every positive epsilon and forcing, all-domain variational identity, local-volume L1 of u/G, ALL C1 compact ordinary weak-gradient products/identity, local squared PDE residual and compact-volume L2, ALL C2 compact ordinary weak-Poisson products/identity, and ALL C2 compact chi actual v/Gchi/Fchi volumeL2/support/weak identities. Derive m*norm(D.closureu)^2<=norm(f-epsilon*u)^2<=normf^2 by actual weighted radial cutoff/commutator convergence and true compact scalar inequalities, retaining zero dimension.
assumptions: Finite real Hilbert/Borel E, including dimension0; canonical full-space volume. W is C2, exp(-W) genuinely integrable and Z positive. The actual input mu equals volume.tilted(-W). Real constants satisfy 0<m<=M and all-point/all-vector m*norma^2<=HessW(x)[a,a]<=M*norma^2. Both bounds are used to derive true linear drift.

Original weighted L2 partial real-linear gradient D is closable with its exact graph: actual AE classes of compact C-infinity functions and their genuine gradients. D precedes every epsilon>0 and f in L2(mu). No final closed-domain, generator-core, limit or coercivity certificate is given. The actual resolvent is constructed from this original graph.

formulae.label: Actual global weighted resolvent scalar coercivity
formulae.tex: \exists u\in\operatorname{dom}\overline D:\quad\varepsilon\langle u,v\rangle+\langle\overline Du,\overline Dv\rangle=\langle f,v\rangle\ (\forall v),\quad m\|\overline Du\|_\mu^2\le\|f-\varepsilon u\|_\mu^2\le\|f\|_\mu^2.

obligations.label: Actual same-u positive-epsilon global scalar coercivity
Both main results and actual-input expected-cost composition (remaining)

bindings.boundary: Same original compact-smooth gradient D precedes epsilon/f; derive ONE actual variational/localized resolvent u and actual weighted radial cutoff/commutator limits. Prove m*norm(D.closure u)^2<=norm(f-epsilon*u)^2<=normf^2 with source C2/two-sided0<m<=M Hessian bounds. E0 retained. No final limit/coercivity/core certificate, extra norm(x)*u moment, global ordinary Laplacian or drift-product L2, C-infinity potential, epsilon0/kernel/constant-domain/range/Poincare/BL/adjoint/core/jointselector/main/composition is inferred. Reflected quarter/fourfold constants exact; TV never transfers unbounded cost.
